bundle.shortDescription: Download MP3 from YouTube, TikTok and Spotify
bundle.longDescription: Fluent MP3 saves music from YouTube, TikTok and Spotify links as MP3 files with cover art, artist, album and year embedded. Search by name, download playlists, edit tags. Designed with Microsoft Fluent Design (Mica, Acrylic, Mica Alt).
